value.rationale: A complete natural 2RiDF spectrum and all optimizer types for the canonical ten-vertex Petersen graph fills a meaningful gap left by scalar minimum results; the two-term spectrum is structurally unexpected, 30 minima form a single geometric orbit, and all 80 other feasible labelings split into four natural, precisely characterized orbits. The K5 intersecting-family reduction explains this rigidity, making the result useful as a rigorous benchmark for the same invariant.
